hero_ninja_down.png.prompt:
The character: the small grey tabby kitten ninja from the reference image (dark navy ninja suit and headband, big round eyes).

Pose: knocked out and collapsed on the ground - the fight is over and he has gone down. He lies crumpled on his side in a compact heap, front paws folded loosely in front of him, back legs tucked, tail flopped out limp behind. His navy headband has slipped off and lies beside him, one trailing tail of it draped across his paw. Both eyes are drawn as two simple X shapes - two crossed lines each, the classic cartoon knocked-out eyes - and his mouth hangs open in a small slack circle. Completely limp: nothing tensed, nothing held up. One small dried fish has rolled out of his belt and rests just in front of his nose, out of reach. This is comic defeat, not suffering: no tears, no blood, no wounds, no pain lines, no impact stars

Full body, head toward the RIGHT. He lies flat with his body along the very bottom edge of the picture - do not draw him floating and do not stand him up. Because he is lying down he will be wider than he is tall: fill the frame horizontally and leave the upper part empty.
Keep the exact same character design as the reference image (same face, same fur pattern, same clothing) - only the pose and expression differ.
The action must be big and readable at small size: bold silhouette, strong shapes. Only ONE character in the picture.
Draw everything SOLID and OPAQUE - flat filled colour with soft shading. Nothing transparent or see-through.
Nothing else in the picture: no ground line, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no letters, no watermark, no border.
Style: thick black outlines, flat colors with subtle soft gradients, cute cartoon look, not photorealistic.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying. Nothing green on the character.
Output 1024x1024 PNG. Save the image as hero_ninja_down.png in the current directory and report the path.
